tagline: Early cash generation through bulk sample processing to validate project economics
hero_kpi_rationale: The indicated resources of 472 koz at 3.63 g/t form the foundation of the project's technical feasibility and the primary short-term value catalyst. The bulk sample will validate project economics before full development and generate initial cash flows.

risks.title: Dependency on exploration partnerships and financing
risks.score_rationale: Major risk identified in financial notes (Note 10a): ITOCHU withdrew financing from the MAN project in November 2013 after investing US$24.2M. The company relies on joint ventures and property sales to finance exploration. Moderate language but significant financial impact (impairment of $18.2M). Trend stable but structural.

risks.title: Impairment and depreciation of exploration properties
risks.score_rationale: Documented history of significant impairments (Note 10 and 21): MAN impairment of $18.2M (2013), Raglan $361.7K (2015), Rainbow $28.1K (2014). Portfolio of $28.2M in exploration properties (Note 10) exposed to depreciation risk. Factual language but repeated pattern of downward adjustments.

risks.title: Royalty and third-party back-in rights risk
risks.score_rationale: Properties acquired from Glencore (former Falconbridge) subject to 2% NSR royalty and 50% working interest back-in right (Note 10e). Milford (Utah) royalty interest of $1.2M with US$8M cap. Clear language but impact limited by caps. Stable structural risk.

risks.title: Geopolitical and regulatory risk of US properties
risks.score_rationale: Significant portfolio in Alaska (MAN, Salt Chuck) and Utah (Milford) exposed to federal and state US regulation. Note 10 details US properties. Neutral language but current geopolitical context (permitting, environment) creates risk. Trend up with tightening mining regulation.

risks.title: Geographic concentration and mining title risk
risks.score_rationale: Portfolio concentrated: Quebec $21.1M (74% of properties), Manitoba $4.4M, Saskatchewan $2.1M (Note 10, segmentation Note 17). Dependency on claim renewal (Raglan, Rainbow abandoned). Factual language but high concentration creates systemic risk.

risks.title: Financing and liquidity risk for ongoing exploration
risks.score_rationale: Company in exploration stage (stage company) with net loss of $95K over 9 months (Note 15). Cash of $1.2M (Note 18) insufficient to finance multi-year exploration. Dependency on future capital raises (Note 19: 'raising additional share capital when market conditions are suitable'). Risk explicitly stated.

risks.title: Share dilution and stock price volatility risk
risks.score_rationale: 68.1M shares outstanding (Note 12). Options outstanding: 3.15M (Note 13) with exercise prices of $0.04-$0.05. Estimated volatility 87-139% (Black-Scholes Note 13). Financing through capital raises dilutes existing shareholders. Technical language but structural risk.

ai_positioning.summary: The company mentions no use of artificial intelligence in its operating model, exploration, or development processes. The West Cache project is entirely focused on traditional exploration and mining extraction with an emphasis on bulk sampling.
evidence: No mention of AI in the provided documents
No digital tools or predictive analytics referenced
Exclusive focus on drilling, bulk sampling, and metallurgy
